summary: Master cost optimization and profitability analysis with hands-on ABC, ZBB, and value engineering. Enroll now to drive margin expansion and operational efficien
lede: Cost Optimization and Profitability Analysis helps professionals uncover hidden cost drivers, assess value per unit, and improve resource allocation through structured, data-backed financial practices. The course covers Activity-Based Costing, Zero-Based Budgeting, Total Cost of Ownership, spend cube analysis, value engineering, profitability dashboards, and supplier contract analysis. Through practical workshops, you will calculate NPV and ROI, map value streams, build spend cubes, and create 12-month sustainability plans. The course also introduces AI-powered expense tracking and predictive demand forecasting, using actionable frameworks that support results under budget limits, complex supply chains, and technology adoption gaps without requiring advanced coding or proprietary software.

prerequisites: Participants should have foundational understanding of financial statements, time value of money concepts, and basic investment analysis. Access to Excel with data analysis tools is essential for hands-on modeling exercises. While not required, experience with operational processes or industry exposure will enhance learning outcomes. No coding is required for completion.
